source = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pairs = []
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background:
                continue
            for dc in (-1, 1):
                nc = c + dc
                if 0 <= nc < w and grid[r + 1][nc] == color:
                    pairs.append((r, c, r + 1, nc, color))
    if len(pairs) < 3:
        return out
    for r1, c1, r2, c2, color in pairs:
        dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
        for r, c, sr, sc in ((r1, c1, -dr, -dc), (r2, c2, dr, dc)):
            rr, cc = r + sr, c + sc
            while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == background:
                out[rr][cc] = color
                rr += sr
                cc += sc
    return out
'''
